name: iris-wipe
title: Iris Wipe
description: A classic iris: the outgoing scene closes to a small dot on a solid color, then the incoming scene opens from the same point. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .irw-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A retro, cartoon or film-style scene change that closes one scene and opens the next.
Drawing the eye to a specific point (set the center) between two scenes.
avoidWhen: The tone is modern and minimal: use a fade or slide.
The iris color would clash with both scenes.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Color
variables.description: Fill shown outside the iris while it is closed.

variables.label: Hold radius
variables.description: Radius of the held dot as a percentage of the frame diagonal.
